findings.evidence: ## Worked review ... "Decision: repeat Rep 1 once with a template check before each send" restates the 'Shipped, execution inconsistent' row of the step 4 table
findings.fix: Cut the worked review to the one line the table does not already teach: process evidence (6 of 10 on template) outranks the outcome (1 reply), so the outcome is not read at all

findings.evidence: "Keep only lessons that change what the user does and can be tested in one rep." is the only extraction heuristic; there is no thinking prompt for turning an abstract principle into a testable action
findings.fix: Add a before-X question to step 2, for example: 'For each lesson ask: what would I see the user do differently tomorrow, and what single artifact proves it? If there is no answer, drop the lesson.'

findings.evidence: The Gotchas cover motivational claims, market gating, disproved hypotheses, false provenance and false save claims, but none covers a Rep 1 that quietly exceeds the user's stated time budget
findings.fix: Add: 'Never let setup (accounts, tools, research) eat the Rep 1 budget: users count only the shipping steps, so the rep overruns and fails as Not shipped. Put setup time in the step estimates.'

findings.evidence: No eval checks the default save behaviour of step 5 (file named 'Ship-Learn-Next Plan - <brief title>.md' written only after the write succeeds); provided-content asserts on plan content only
findings.fix: Add an assertion to 'provided-content': 'Writes the plan to a file named Ship-Learn-Next Plan - <title>.md and reports the path only after the write succeeds'

findings.evidence: Step 4 (review) never says whether it then runs step 5: when a rep is reviewed, it is unclear whether to update the existing plan file, write a new one, or answer in chat; step 5 lists contents only for a new plan
findings.fix: End step 4 with: 'Then go to step 5: if the plan file exists, append a "Rep N review" section and the expanded next rep to it; otherwise put the review and next rep in the reply.'
